verdict.rationale: Discord's bot platform (bot tokens, Gateway API for real-time events like message creation, slash commands/interactions) provides the technical building blocks for a third-party developer to build and add an AI agent as a bot that listens for mentions and responds in a channel — this is exactly how many AI bots operate on Discord. However, this requires custom bot development rather than being a native, out-of-the-box 'add an AI agent member' feature, and no docs specifically describe mention-triggered AI response patterns. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of mention-detection/response patterns, a first-party AI agent template or example bot, and independent/hands-on evidence of an AI bot working this way in production.
